paper_title: Production rates of dark photons and $Z'$ in the Sun and stellar cooling bounds
notes: Paper derives stellar (solar) cooling bounds for multiple U(1) models: dark photon (kinetic mixing epsilon), B-L, Lmu-Ltau, Le-Lmu(tau). I extracted the B-L (VectorBL) solar bound, which the paper states as g_Z' < 4.1e-10 (flat) for m_Z' <~ 10 keV; the bound becomes flat at low mass due to nn/np coupling asymmetry. Encoded as a horizontal line over the flat region ~1e-4 to 1e4 eV. Ambiguity: the paper presents several coupling types (DarkPhoton epsilon, VectorBL g_BL, Lmu-Ltau, Le-Lmu). Per instructions B-L strongly favors VectorBL. Full mass-dependent curves are in Fig. 4 (not digitizable from text). Le-Lmu(tau) analogous bound is 3.9e-11.
